steps.title: Initialize App Meta and Package Configuration
steps.description: Establish the global package name 'com.moderncalculator.app' and define app metadata configuration for Modern Calculator.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with target/compile SDK 34, min SDK 21, and define Java 8 source and target compatibility settings.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml, validating the core namespace and defining MainActivity as the main launcher activity using default Material Theme.

steps.title: Define Color Palette Resources
steps.description: Create colors.xml containing custom modern dark-slate and electric-blue design colors for a beautiful UI aesthetic.

steps.title: Define String Resources
steps.description: Populate strings.xml with standard configuration labels and basic visual text structures for button values.

steps.title: Design Number Button Drawable
steps.description: Create custom rounded slate-gray background shape with state selectors for number keys to ensure clear visual feedback on touch.

steps.title: Design Operator Button Drawable
steps.description: Create custom high-contrast electric-blue state selector background drawable for primary mathematical operators.

steps.title: Design Action Button Drawable
steps.description: Create custom dark-gray active background for helper action keys like Clear, Backspace, and Percentage.

steps.title: Design Equals Button Drawable
steps.description: Create vibrant orange/coral button style specifically highlighting the ultimate completion action (=).

steps.title: Construct Modern Layout XML Structure
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml layout structure. Implement a dual-line scrolling digital display header and nested row weights for responsive button layouts.

steps.title: Develop MainActivity Shell & Fields
steps.description: Create MainActivity.java structure, importing necessary native SDK modules, declaring active display elements, and tracking calculation states.

steps.title: Implement Display Formatting Engine
steps.description: Write numerical formatting functions inside MainActivity to beautifully format double outputs, handling precision limits and scientific representation cleanly.

steps.title: Create Click Listener Framework
steps.description: Set up native programmatic click handlers for numeric inputs, updating display values iteratively on keypress.

steps.title: Integrate Basic Mathematical Operators
steps.description: Incorporate arithmetic state routing to execute and display standard expressions (Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division).

steps.title: Develop Advanced Modifiers
steps.description: Add logic for inline modular actions like percentage logic, dynamic sign inversion (+/-), backspace operations, and full calculator resets (C).

steps.title: Verify UI Rendering & Interaction Polish
steps.description: Perform final check of component interaction flow, handling large digit entries, overflow scenarios, and dividing by zero safely.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile the complete codebase utilizing Gradle 8.5 to produce the final executable Android APK.
